workLog.detail: Issue #4691 open, no PR, main still declares merge_group in 0 of 62 workflows, so main does not supersede the branch. Local worktree found at ai-agents2-fix-4691 on fix/4691-merge-group-support.

The 2026-08-08 session-10021 log and its episode were removed. Both were added by this branch, so session_scope classifies them as a creation-mode claim that must be complete, and that session ended blocked with no qaValidation and an endingCommit the rebase orphaned. Its findings are carried in this log's investigate and measure entries rather than left as an incomplete claim.

Prior blocker re-measured rather than retried. The workflow-local-run gate full-acts every changed workflow per job at a 600 second budget. test-codeql-integration.yml installs a 788,113,376 byte CodeQL bundle with --force and budgets 15 to 20 CI minutes per job, so no local run can fit. The catthehacker runner images were already cached on 2026-07-29, before the 2026-08-08 failure, so no new cache exists and the large download was not repeated.

Queried ruleset 11104075 live. It now requires 16 contexts, not the 17 the issue recorded. Aggregate Results was retired and main renamed its two survivors to AI Quality Gate Results and Session Protocol Results, which is why the rebased test reported name drift.

Mapped all 16 live contexts to producing jobs. Every one resolves to 10 workflows. ai-session-protocol.yml and test-codeql-integration.yml produce none, so both return to their main content and leave the readiness contract. The refresh command for the context set now sits next to it in the test.

Rebased 8 commits onto origin/main twice, resolving three conflicts: memory-validation.yml kept main's quoting with the branch's SHOULD_VALIDATE condition, ai-session-protocol.yml merged inputs.pr_number with github.ref and !cancelled() before the file was reverted, memory-index.md took main.

110 tests pass across test_merge_group_readiness.py, test_workflow_trigger_fanout.py, test_frontmatter_gate_paths_filter.py, and test_determine_should_run_from_filters.py. Loading the readiness checks against the origin/main workflow tree produced 27 errors, which is the non-vacuity control the issue asks for.
